description: DEPRECATED — prefer `homes_get_history` (combined timelines + tax) or `homes_get_property({ url, include_tax_history: true })`. Same data, fewer round trips; note that `homes_get_history` returns the tax array as `tax_records` (not `records`). Will be removed in a future major version. Year-by-year property-tax records: tax paid, total assessed value, land/improvement split.
